CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **Brick Work**, a free, open-source workbench for a brick collection: check a set's parts, pull the missing parts from your loose stock, and see which unfinished sets that stock can complete.
Questions and help: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Ulef1005/brick-work/discussions). Bugs: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Ulef1005/brick-work/issues).
